name: Alex Language Explorer
subtitle: Phrases in a voice they know
promotional_text: Explore a room and hear its phrases in a familiar voice. No ads, no account, no scores. Recordings stay on the device.
review_notes: No account or sign-in. The first screen is the adults' profile picker: create a profile, then the child's room opens. Adult controls open on a 2-second hold so a child's tap never reaches them. Hold any object for 2 seconds to record its phrase. The privacy policy is shown inside the app, on the profile picker.

testflight.description: Alex is a small app for children who learn language in whole phrases. A caregiver sets up a profile and records phrases in their own voice; the child explores a room and hears them.
testflight.what_to_test: Make a profile, explore the room, open Words, and record a phrase by holding an object for two seconds. The profile picker shows this build in its bottom-right corner. Report anything that looks wrong or gets in the way.
testflight.review_notes: No account or sign-in. Adult screens open on a 2-second hold. Recording needs the microphone, asked on first launch.
